title: update mecanumWheelRollingDiscTest
author: JG
description: update w.r.t. Trajectory class and TorsionalSpringDamper
releaseNotes: mecanumWheelRollingDiscTest follows a Trajectory of [x, y, phi]; its velocities are the velocityOffset of TorsionalSpringDamper motors between car and wheels, set in a PreStepUserFunction, so the motor torque reacts on the car; the car follows 20 s of trajectory to 1 cm, the test runs the first 4 s (revision2026c step RG11.8.14)
